overview.description: The Franklin U.S. Low Volatility High Dividend Index ETF (LVHD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of roughly 50-100 US stocks selected from across the market cap spectrum. Stocks are selected and weighted to emphasize profitability, high dividends, low price volatility and low earnings volatility. LVHD was launched on Dec 29, 2015 and is issued by Franklin Templeton.
